notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry is specific to this tower; it gives no build date, staffing, fire or access information, so the story is short. The Dispatch article (January 9, 2020) concerns Oktibbeha County and state practice; it is cited only as general context, not as a record of this tower. The 100 ft height is converted to 30.5 m. Two searches and one archive-style source were tried; no MFC record or newspaper on this tower was found. Worth checking MFC property records or local papers for build date and retirement date. Brief's elevation (170.4 m) matches the NHLR figure.
